title: Born on September 4th: the man who first made Britain listen to India.
caption:
Born on September 4th: the man who first made Britain listen to India.

Born in Navsari, Gujarat, in 1825. A scholar, merchant, and the man later called the 'Grand Old Man of India' — decades before independence was even a mainstream demand.

In 1892, Naoroji became the first Indian ever elected to the British House of Commons — winning by just 5 votes. He used the seat to argue, in Britain's own parliament, that colonial rule was draining India's wealth.

Every generation since has had to do the same — in institutions, in industry, in the sectors now shaping India's next 20 years. That instinct is the throughline to Viksit Bharat 2047.
